bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: A new developer group unveiled a $10 billion proposal to build a 75,000-seat domed stadium in Chicago's Bronzeville neighborhood on the old Michael Reese Hospital site, aiming to keep the Bears in the city, though the Chicago Bears have not returned WGN-TV's request for comment on this story . On the field, the Chicago Bears slip into first place in the NFC North following the Minnesota Vikings' loss to the Buffalo Bills , moving them up to the No.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are in Munich, Germany preparing for their Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots, with head coach Dan Campbell speaking to the media on November 13 at the FC Bayern Campus. The Lions have made a roster move involving a veteran linebacker before their Week 10 clash against the New England Patriots , elevating Owen Pappoe to the active roster, while the team also deals with injury concerns surrounding wide receiver Amon-Ra St.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers have officially ruled out four players ahead of Sunday's crucial NFC North showdown against the Minnesota Vikings, including running back Josh Jacobs (finger), edge rusher Micah Parsons (knee/illness), center Sean Rhyan, and tight end Josh Whyle, while listing seven others—including safety Xavier McKinney—as questionable. With Jacobs sidelined, the Packers are expected to lean on MarShawn Lloyd as they try to extend their winning momentum against Minnesota at Lambeau Field.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kirk Cousins has been confirmed as the Vikings' starting quarterback for Sunday's Week 10 showdown at Green Bay, just five days after being acquired in a trade with the Las Vegas Raiders , and he'll wear his old No. 8 jersey in the pivotal NFC North matchup.
